q: 1. Engineering profession needs cooperation with the profession of
explain: Engineering projects often require inputs from medical (safety/health), accounting (finance), and legal (contracts) professionals, so cooperation with all these professions is needed.

q: 2. Which type of membership is not categorized in NEC act 2055?
explain: Senior divisional, superintending and chief engineer are civil service posts, not NEC membership categories, so all of them are not categorized.

q: 3. The total number of members in Nepal engineering council is
explain: As per the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055, the Council is constituted with a total of 18 members.

q: 4. The tenure of registrar of Nepal engineering council is ........
explain: The book's answer key gives 4 years. Note that Q66 asks the same thing and the key gives 2 years there, so the book is inconsistent; verify against the NEC Act.

q: 5. According to Labour Act, maximum working hour for a labour per week should be
explain: The Nepal Labour Act sets the maximum weekly working hours for a labourer at 48 hours.

q: 6. The minimum qualification required for a general engineer is
explain: A General Engineer must hold at least a Bachelor's degree in engineering for registration with NEC.

q: 7. The number of members in Nepal Engineers' Association are
explain: The executive committee representation structure historically defines core office bearers/members standard groupings in the association setup.

q: 8. The minimum qualification & experience required for the registration of foreigner engineers is
options: bachelor in engineering and 5 years' experience
bachelor in engineering and 10 yrs experience
master in engineering and 5 yrs experience
master in engineering and 10 yrs experience
explain: Foreign engineers must have a Bachelor's degree in engineering with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience to register in Nepal.

q: 9. NEC regulation 2057, is effective from ........
explain: As per the answer key, the regulation came into effect on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 10. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ मा कतिवटा दफा रहेछन् ?
explain: The primary legislation of the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 consists of a total of 38 sections (दफा).

q: 11. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषदले श्री ५ को सरकारसँग सम्पर्क राख्दा कुन मंत्रालय मार्फत सम्पर्क राख्नु पर्ने छ ?
explain: The parent line ministry representing the Nepal Engineering Council to the Government is the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 12. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् नियमालवी, २०५७ सम्बन्धी कुन गलत छ ?
options: ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले गरेको हो ।
ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले NEC Act 2055 को दफा ३७ बमोजिम गरेको हो ।
explain: Both statements (a) and (b) correctly reflect how NEC Regulation 2057 was framed under Section 37 authority, making none of the options incorrect.

q: 13. Professional code of conduct issued by Nepal Engineering Council has
explain: The Professional Code of Conduct issued by NEC is organized into 8 articles covering various aspects of professional behavior.

q: 14. As per the NEC Act, 2055 the name of engineers
explain: The legislative categorizations specified for membership registers are General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreigner Engineer.

q: 15. NEC Regulation, 2057 is effective from
explain: Nepal Engineering Council Regulations 2057 came into legal force officially on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 16. Who is the chairperson of central labour advisory board (CLAB)?
options: Director general, department of labour member
explain: The Central Labour Advisory Board (CLAB) is chaired by the Labour Minister (or State Minister for Labour) as per the Labour Act.

q: 17. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in engineering council rule, 2057 for registration?
explain: The rule recognizes general, professional and foreign (non-Nepali) engineers. Chartered engineer is not a registration category.

q: 18. Which one type of membership is not categorized by NEC?
explain: Superintendent Engineer is a promotional departmental designation in civil services rather than a registration category under NEC Act.

q: 19. For the registiration of professinal engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: The official fee for registration under the Professional Engineer category is set at NRs 10,000.

q: 20. The registered engineers in Nepal engineering council should have to renew their registration in ........
explain: The answer key gives 'none of these', meaning the renewal interval is not one of the listed periods.

q: 21. In general, Nepal engineering council meeting per year should be held ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council meets four times a year.

q: 22. What is the provision in engineer council act and regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices engineering work without registering into the Nepal engineering council?
options: Rs. 3000 fine or imprisonment of three months or both
Rs. 1000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both
explain: As per the answer key, the penalty is a Rs. 3000 fine or three months' imprisonment, or both.

q: 23. NEC publishes the name of registered engineers each year as well as every forth year. The name of foreigner engineers publish
explain: The published roster of registered foreign engineers is updated and released annually by the Council.

q: 24. Which of the following category of Engineer is not mentioned in Engineering Council rule
explain: 'Chartered Engineer' is a designation used in foreign systems (like the UK) and is not a formal category under NEC rules.

q: 25. In general, Nepal Engineering Council meeting per year should be held:
explain: As per NEC rules, the Council is required to hold its general meeting four times a year.

q: 26. Which one is not concerned with NEC
options: authority of opening engineering college me
explain: NEC focuses on regulating engineering professional registration and academic recognition rather than granting college establishment permits.

q: 27. गैह्र नेपाली दर्तावालामा इन्जिनियरको कार्यविधि समाप्त भएपछि काम लगाउने संस्थाको अनुरोधमा परिषद‌ले उपयुक्त ठानेमा एक पटकमाको अवधि भन्दा बढी नहुने गरी जति सुकै पटक पनि त्यस्तो दर्ता नवीकरण गरिदिन सक्नेछ ।
explain: Upon employer request, the council can extend/renew foreign engineer registration for a duration not exceeding 1 year at a time.

q: 28. The decision of the Nepal Engineering Council meeting minute is authenticated by
explain: The minutes of NEC meetings are authenticated by the Member Secretary of the Council.

q: 29. परिषद्मा नाम दर्ता नगराई इन्जिनियरिङ व्यवसाय गरेमा कति रुपैयासम्म जरिवाना गरिनेछ ?
explain: Practicing engineering without mandatory registration in NEC carries a legal penalty/fine up to NRs 3,000 as per Section 31.

q: 30. Which is the concerned line ministry for Nepal Engineering Council (NEC)?
options: Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport
explain: NEC operates under the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport, which is the concerned line ministry overseeing engineering-related regulatory bodies.

q: 31. NEC categories the engineers into ........
explain: NEC registers engineers in 3 categories: general, professional and foreign.

q: 32. Nepal engineering council (NEC) is a
explain: NEC was established as an autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act, independent of direct government administration.

q: 33. The Nepal Engineering council act, 2055 defines a engineer as a person who holds
options: at least bachelor degree in any engineering subject
at least masters degree in engineering subject
at least Diploma in any engineering subjects
explain: As per NEC Act 2055, an 'engineer' is defined as a person holding at least a bachelor's degree in any engineering subject.

q: 34. Any non- Nepali Engineer desiring to work in Nepal may apply for registration under
options: Category C B.E. and 10 years of experience
explain: Non-Nepali engineers seeking registration in Nepal must apply under a category requiring a Bachelor's degree in engineering plus 10 years of experience.

q: 35. Which act regulates the engineering profession in Nepal
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act specifically governs and regulates the engineering profession in Nepal.

q: 36. Nepal Engineering Council is an autonomous body formed under
explain: NEC was formed as an autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 B.S.

q: 37. The general experience required for the nominations of chairperson of Nepal Engineering Council after receiving Master's degree is
explain: A candidate nominated for NEC Chairperson must have at least 15 years of general experience after obtaining a Master's degree.

q: 38. The tenure of NEA member is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the tenure is 2 years.

q: 39. According to labour act, maximum working hour for a labour per week should be
explain: The Labour Act sets the maximum weekly working hours for a laborer at 48 hours.

q: 40. The minimum qualification required for a general engineer is ........
explain: A bachelor's degree in engineering is the minimum for registration as a general engineer, per the answer key.

q: 41. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in Engineer Council Rule, 2057 for Registration?
explain: The NEC Rule 2057 categories are General Registered, Professional, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer; 'Chartered Engineer' is not among these categories.

q: 42. NEC contacts with government through ........
options: ministry of physical infrastructure and transport
explain: As per the answer key, NEC liaises with the government through the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 43. Nepal engineering council is an autonomous body formed under act in
explain: NEC was formed as an autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act enacted in 2055 B.S.

q: 44. What is the provision in Engineer Council Act and Regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices Engineering work without registering into the Nepal Engineering Council?
options: Rs 1000 find or imprisonment of 1 month or both
Rs3000 fine or Imprisonment of 3 month of both
explain: Section 31 of NEC Act provides a maximum fine of NRs 3,000 or up to 3 months imprisonment (or both) for unauthorized illegal practice.
